recipes.name: Classic Roasted Chicken Salad Bowl

ingredients.name: Roasted Chicken
ingredients.quantity: One-third of the whole chicken, shredded

recipes.instructions: 1. Shred the meat from one-third of the roasted chicken, discarding skin and bones. 2. In a large bowl, combine half of the Shredded Salad Mix and the two diced Large Tomatoes. 3. Add the five halved Cherry Tomatoes to the mixture. 4. Place the shredded roasted chicken on top of the salad mixture. 5. Toss gently before serving to ensure even distribution of ingredients.

recipes.name: Chicken and Cherry Tomato Stuffed Tomatoes

ingredients.name: Roasted Chicken
ingredients.quantity: One-third of the whole chicken, finely diced

ingredients.name: Shredded Salad Mix
ingredients.quantity: A quarter of the container, minced

recipes.instructions: 1. Prepare the stuffing: Finely dice the meat from one-third of the roasted chicken. Mix it thoroughly with the five finely chopped Cherry Tomatoes. 2. Prepare the shells: Carefully cut the tops off the three Large Tomatoes and scoop out the pulp, creating sturdy shells. 3. Lightly press a small amount of the minced Shredded Salad Mix into the bottom of each hollow tomato shell for a base. 4. Fill each Large Tomato shell generously with the chicken and cherry tomato stuffing. 5. Serve immediately as a fresh appetizer or light meal.

recipes.name: Carved Chicken Platter with Layered Tomato Salad

ingredients.name: Roasted Chicken
ingredients.quantity: Remaining one-third of the whole chicken, carved

recipes.instructions: 1. Carefully carve the final third of the roasted chicken into appealing serving slices or quarters. Arrange the pieces on a serving platter. 2. Slice the remaining Large Tomato thinly and arrange the slices around the carved chicken pieces. 3. In a small bowl, combine the remaining Shredded Salad Mix and the five halved Cherry Tomatoes. 4. Layer this salad mixture attractively over and around the chicken and tomato slices, using it as a fresh, crisp garnish. 5. Serve the platter immediately, allowing the components to be combined on individual plates.
